_note: One closing analytical sentence per case, appended to the Answer section to meet the 350-600 word target. Each interprets the published numbers rather than restating them.

additions.a: The reporting multiple is the more durable of the two speed figures, because management reporting is repeatable work with a fixed shape, while document processing time depends on the mix of client documents and will move as volumes change.

Revenue per employee is the right headline here, because it captures both the hours removed and the work retained, whereas delivery capacity per head could rise simply by lowering the standard of what is delivered.

The survival-rate range is the more telling number, because it moves a biological outcome rather than a cost line, and biological outcomes are harder to attribute to any single management change than a feed bill is.

The recovered amount is a floor rather than a ceiling, because it measures only damage billed within two months, and says nothing about damage prevented, disputes avoided, or repairs found before a vehicle left the lot.

The value of the agent compounds with market coverage, because every additional jurisdiction adds employment law that must be retrieved correctly rather than recalled from memory, and a wrong answer carries a regulatory cost.

Yield consistency is the number that matters commercially, because a vertical farm's economics depend on predictable throughput across cycles rather than on peak output in a good one, and consistency is what buyers contract for.

The coaching multiple is larger than the doctor multiple, which fits the design: coaching is routine guidance that a model can carry between consultations, while clinical judgement cannot be delegated without a governance answer.

The rule-change figure is the one that alters the commercial model, because it moves a task from engineering to operations without moving accountability, which is the difference between selling hours and selling a platform.

The monthly saving is small in absolute terms, which is precisely why it matters here: at this order volume the fix had to be cheap enough to justify itself quickly, and a large platform investment would not have paid back.

Revenue growth is the least attributable figure in the citation, because course production speed is one input among several, alongside demand for AI skills, pricing, and the sales capacity to fill the additional courses produced.

The revenue figure is the strongest evidence in the citation, because it is the only one that shows an external buyer paying for the capability, rather than the company measuring its own internal efficiency.

A cost reduction of this size changes which briefs are viable, not only how profitably existing ones are delivered, because a client with a modest budget can now be offered a multi-location treatment that was previously out of reach.

The return figure is approximate, but the hours figure is the one a practice can test against its own timesheets before committing, which makes it the more useful number for another firm deciding whether to build the same thing.

Bills-of-materials preparation is the sharper figure, because it measures a bounded task with a clear before and after, whereas sourcing time blends several activities that a distributor may define differently.

The contamination figure is the commercial one, because clients buy a reduction in incidents rather than the accuracy of the measurement behind it, though the accuracy figure is what makes the incident count defensible in a report.

Review coverage is the number to watch, because it converts quality assurance from a sample into a control that can be audited, and an audited control is what a regulated client will pay for in an outsourcing contract.

The video figure matters most for an agency, because production latency is what limits how many creative concepts a client can afford to test, and testing volume is usually the constraint on performance improvement.

Percentage gains on a small base flatter a site rebuild, so the absolute traffic and booking numbers would be needed before treating this as a repeatable playbook rather than a single successful relaunch.

The output increase is the strategic figure, because it changes how many concepts the agency can put in front of a client within one budget, which affects win rates more than a marginal reduction in cost per asset.

The daily hours figure is more meaningful than the annual saving, because it describes capacity returned to the development team, and that capacity is what a logistics operator would otherwise have to buy in.
The compliance automation is the part that protects the speed gain, because faster proposals without a checking step would simply move risk downstream to the client relationship and the contract.

The content multiple is modest next to the labour saving, which suggests the real constraint was production capacity rather than creative ambition, and that the tools removed a bottleneck rather than expanded demand.

Conversion is the figure to watch, because scheduling and stock accuracy reach the customer as machine availability, and availability is the thing a site manager is actually buying when comparing suppliers.

The hours figure matters operationally, because it represents teaching capacity returned rather than cost removed, and a centre can convert returned hours into classes more easily than it can convert a budget saving into revenue.

A return of this size on a small studio suggests a low absolute cost base, so the payback period and the cash outlay matter more than the multiple, which will fall sharply once the initial tooling cost is behind the firm.

Response speed is the figure with a direct commercial consequence, because a slow reply in social selling usually means a lost shortlist place, and no amount of additional campaign output recovers a lead that went elsewhere.

On-time payment reaching 100% is the strongest signal, because it depends on reminders, invoicing and booking records working together rather than on any single feature, and it is the outcome least likely to be flattered by measurement.

Payback within five months is the figure a restaurant group will test first, because food cost changes arrive monthly and any tool that takes a year to pay for itself will be judged against a very short operating horizon.

The sites-processed figure is the strategic one, because it changes the unit of analysis from individual junctions to a network, and a network view is what makes proactive safety spending defensible to a road authority.

The exception rate, which the citation does not publish, will decide whether the saving holds as invoice volume grows, because every exception returns work to the same small team that the automation was meant to release.
